newsitem.title: USA: Public Service/New Mexico ups qtrly div.
newsitem.headline: Public Service/New Mexico ups qtrly div.

text.p: Public Service Co of New Mexico Wednesday said it is increasing its quarterly common stock dividend by $0.05 to $0.12 per share. The new rate is effective with the first quarter 1997 dividend, to be paid May 23 to shareholders of record as of May 12.

"A little more than two years ago, PNM was able to offer customers a $30 million rate reduction. Last year, the company's continued success allowed us to reinstate the common stock dividend to PNM shareholders," said PNM President and Chief Executive Officer Benjamin Montoya."Today's announcement is consistent with the company's commitment to providing a competitive return to investors, which in turn allows us to provide reliable service to New Mexico customers."

"We also continue to work toward regaining an investment grade credit rating through additional retirement and refinancing of long-term debt, and we continue to invest in the business," Montoya said. "This year alone, PNM will invest more than $150 million in capital improvements to bolster system reliability, better serve current customers, and extend PNM electric and gas services to new customers."
The new annual rate of $0.68 per share represents a payout of about 40 percent of 1996 earnings of $1.72 per share.
